question: When did Algeria officially become a member of the New Development Bank (NDB)?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Thu May 01 2025 00:00:00 GMT+0530 (India Standard Time)**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Algeria officially became a member of the New Development Bank (NDB) on May 1, 2025.**
 
• The New Development Bank (NDB) was established in 2014 by the BRICS countries (Brazil, Russia, India, China, and South Africa).
 
• Algeria's membership reflects the bank's aim to expand its outreach beyond the BRICS nations and include emerging economies globally.
 
• The decision to include Algeria aligns with the NDB's strategy to strengthen its global presence and financial inclusion.
 
• Algeria’s membership is expected to bolster infrastructure development and sustainable projects in the African region.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **New Development Bank (NDB):**

 
 
• It was established by the BRICS nations at the 6th BRICS Summit in Fortaleza, Brazil in 2014.
 
• The NDB is headquartered in Shanghai, China, and focuses on financing infrastructure and sustainable development projects.
 
• It aims to complement existing global financial institutions like the World Bank and the International Monetary Fund (IMF).
 
 
 
• **Algeria’s Economic Landscape:**
 
 
• Algeria is one of Africa's largest economies, primarily driven by its oil and gas sector.
 
• It has been diversifying its economy to reduce reliance on hydrocarbons and focus on sustainable development projects.
 
• Joining the NDB is expected to provide Algeria with access to financial resources for infrastructure and green projects.
 
 
 
• **NDB’s Global Expansion:**
 
 
• The NDB has been expanding its membership to include countries beyond the BRICS group.
 
• Egypt, the United Arab Emirates, and Uruguay are other countries that have joined the NDB recently.
 
• The inclusion of new members reflects the bank's strategy to establish a global footprint.
 
 
 
• **Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs):**
 
 
• The NDB aligns its projects with the United Nations' SDGs, focusing on clean energy, transportation, and water management.
 
• Membership in the NDB allows countries like Algeria to access funding for projects that align with global sustainability goals.
